g.text: Release Payment Hold — Sequence (Aetna → APIc → BFF → CVS)
If status=ELIGIBLE and reason=54, show CTA\n"Change Payment Method".
POST payment-hold:resolve {orderId, rx[], paymentInstrument, consentResponse, memberId}
Consent rejected -> FE shows message; retry allowed
Resolve failed -> audit failure; safe retry with same Idempotency-Key
